dedupe_keys.name: criticita da isole di calore nelle aree urbane

description: Criticità da isole di calore nelle aree urbane is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.csi.it. The resource contains the results of a study conducted on 71 Piedmontese municipalities relating to the distribution of criticality from heat islands in urban areas. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Criticality from heat islands in urban areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Landsat, Temperatura, opendata, NDVI, RNDT, Vulnerabilità. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WMS, TIFF. The listing shows 2024-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
